rationale: User after 040: wezterm-gui inactive pane is slightly darker (Dracula) with a hollow cursor. Default inactive_pane_hsb is brightness 0.8 / saturation 0.9. GPUI has no HSV shader; apply the same RGB→HSV multiply as wezterm-gui shader.wgsl on the 017 line-sprite bitmap. Unfocused cursor is a 1px cursor_border outline, not cursor_bg fill. Do not start 026/031.
